detail.longDescription:
ProCleaner helps you manage device storage with these features:
Core Functions:
- Scan and clean cache files
- Remove residual and junk files
- Find and manage large files
- Uninstall multiple applications
- Monitor network speed
- Check battery status
Technical Requirements:
The app requires storage access to scan and clean files locally. App usage permission is needed to manage installed applications.
All operations are performed locally on your device. No personal files or data are collected or uploaded.
Privacy Policy: https://www.proncleaner.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.proncleaner.com/terms
